messages.author: Eduardo R. Almeida
messages.body:
Dear Amber users,
I would like to know if the summary.TEMP file generated by the process_mdout.perl code corresponds to the average value of temperature involving the files: summary.TSOLUTE and summary.TSOLVENT. I tried to overlay these three files, but it seems that they are very different in terms of scale. Also, I would like to know what is the meaning of the axis in these files (summary.TSOLUTE and summary.TSOLVENT), since I know that summary.TEMP involves temperature versus time (ps).
Best regards,
Eduardo.
